limitations: A last purchase dated 1–5 October is the most recent found in the live queried documents, not a supplier quote dated today.
The 2026-07-01 to 2026-10-08 interval is checked; no-purchase-found is not absence from inventory and not zero cost.

Duplicate/corrected PROCESSED documents can exist; no weighted average is computed from this set. Latest-time identical-price duplicates do not change lastpurchase; differing price/unit would be flagged.
Invoice amountUnit is retained; Nori is per piece, sauces may be per litre, others per kilogram. Do not silently convert litres to kilograms.
Raw fish and cooked/trimmed fish, dry rice and prepared rice, frozen shrimp and prepared shrimp require dated recipe expansion and yield factors.
Site prices are a 7 October confirmed snapshot; fresh 8 October web read was empty. No challenge endpoint bypass attempted.
No API writes, synchronization, order, login, or secret extraction performed.
